about_the_game:
BORZOI is a first-person survival horror game where you are relentlessly hunted by a giant, demonic Borzoi dog.

You play as a park ranger assigned to Foster Park, a once-peaceful nature reserve turned nightmare. Tasked with locating a missing colleague, you quickly realize the park harbors dark secrets. As you explore its eerie trails and abandoned sites, the horrifying truth behind its cursed history comes to light.

RISING DREAD
Armed with only your wits, a flickering flashlight, and scarce resources, every decision matters as you navigate the dangers of Foster Park. Hunted by the relentless BORZOI and its reanimated minions, every sound and move you make could spell your doom. Survival demands careful strategy and quick thinking—actions have consequences.

ESCAPING THE HORROR

Forge your path through a semi-open world filled with deadly secrets and dangers. Solve environmental puzzles, scavenge for resources, and uncover the twisted history of a cult that left behind unimaginable horrors. The deeper you delve, the closer you come to understanding the terror haunting Foster Park.

FEATURES

  • A relentless, unkillable monster that reacts to your every move.

  • Immersive survival mechanics—scavenge, hide, or run for your life.

  • High-stakes puzzles tied to the park’s chilling lore.

  • A semi-open world with mysteries and challenges waiting to be uncovered.

content_descriptors.notes: Since its a survival horror game, there are some jumpscares and zombies you can shoot, that's basically it. It can appear throughout almost all parts of the gameplay after the first cutscene.
